parameters.query:
SELECT 
  id, 
  nome, 
  whatsapp_loja, 
  config_json,
  (SELECT value FROM public.configs WHERE key = 'evolution_webhook_url' LIMIT 1) AS config_evo_webhook,
  (SELECT value FROM public.configs WHERE key = 'webhook_secret' LIMIT 1) AS config_evo_secret
FROM lojas 
WHERE id = $1 
LIMIT 1;

UPDATE lojas
SET 
  whatsapp_loja = CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN $1 ELSE whatsapp_loja END,
  config_json = (
    CASE WHEN $5::boolean THEN
      jsonb_set(
        CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN
          jsonb_set(COALESCE(config_json, '{}'::jsonb), '{dadosDaLoja,whatsapp_loja}', to_jsonb($1::text), true)
        ELSE COALESCE(config_json, '{}'::jsonb) END,
        '{evolutionapi,instanceName}',
        to_jsonb($3::text),
        true
      )
    ELSE
      jsonb_set(COALESCE(config_json, '{}'::jsonb), '{dadosDaLoja,whatsapp_loja}', to_jsonb($1::text), true)
    END
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $2;
